plainTranslation: Emotional intensity tipping into control. Jealousy, buried feelings erupting, manipulation through moods. Failure mode: using emotional power over each other instead of being honest. Drop the manipulation and feel the thing directly; possessiveness isn't devotion.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
